entities.name: Hristo Mihaylov Popov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hristo Mikhailov Popov was a Bulgarian Communist politician and military commander who was a leading participant of the anti-fascist resistance movement in Bulgaria during the Second World War. He was brother of general and defence minister, Ivan Mihailov.
